intro.title: 参加访谈
intro.sub: 在本任务中，你将参加一场简短的访谈。请听每个问题并用自己的话回答。每题有 45 秒作答时间，不提供准备时间。
intro.note: 每段音频只播放一次，且无法返回上一题。不提供准备时间。提示音后开始作答。

brief.title: 参加访谈
brief.sub: You have volunteered for a research study at your university about work experience. You will have a short online interview with a researcher. The researcher will ask you some questions.

feedback.description: 表达流畅，需提升复述完整度与用词准确性。
feedback.footnote: 练习估分仅供参考，不代表官方托福分数。

r.ask: "Please put on your safety goggles before you start."
r.fb: The retelling completeness is 72%, missing the key words in the latter half of the sentence. Focus on the sentence ending.

r.ask: "Always keep your fingers away from the blade."
r.fb: Accurate and clear delivery. Well done.

i.ask: "Have you ever had a part-time job or an internship? Tell me about it."
i.fb: Good fluency, but the reasons lack concrete examples. Add one specific example per reason.

weak.q: 第 4 句：句子后半段 "early next week" 未复述出来。
weak.a: 长句复述时容易漏掉尾部信息。建议练习：先抓主干，再补时间/地点等结尾细节。

weak.q: 访谈第 2 题：理由罗列但缺少具体例子。
weak.a: 回答有观点但展开不足。建议做"每个理由都配一个例子"的展开训练。
